product.name: Monoprice Wireless Omni Directional USB Conference Room Mic and Speaker 360 degree with Noise and Echo Cancellation
product.description: This Wireless Mic and Speaker is designed for use in small to mid‑sized meetings with 1‑10 participants. It connects to a computer wirelessly using a 2.4Ghz wireless connection, so it readily works with most laptops and desktops. It is plug and play through a USB 2.0 connection, so it easy to setup and use. No drivers are needed for Windows®, macOS®, Chrome OS™, and Linux®. Just enable the microphone and camera through your operating system or conferencing app to use.The microphone and speaker are specifically designed for meetings. Echo cancellation and noise reduction ensure clear audio, while the omnidirectional mic is designed to pick up audio from within a 10 foot diameter to minimize background noise.The built‑in rechargeable lithium battery keeps it free from wires in the middle of the conference room table. Use it wirelessly throughout the day, with up to 10 hours of talk time and 4 hours to fully recharge. It can be plugged in to a USB charger, if one is available.This wireless mic and speaker is designed to work with the Monoprice PTZ Camera (35520). The camera can be mounted on the wall next to the video monitor, while the speaker‑mic is wirelessly placed in the middle of the meeting room. This wireless mic and speaker can also be controlled by the PTZ Camera remote control for extra convenience.Features: Designed for small to mid‑sized teams and meetings with 1‑10 peopleEasy plug and play 2.4Ghz wireless through a USB 2.0 connectionAudio optimized for web meetingsBuilt‑in 2600mAh rechargeable lithium battery with up to 10 hours of talk timeNo drivers required for Windows®, macOS®, Chrome OS™, or Linux®For use with the Monoprice PTZ Camera (35520)360° omnidirectional microphone with 10 foot diameter sound pickupFull duplex performance with echo cancellation and noise reduction technology for clear audioSupport Files: User's Manual (Dec 28, 2018)Dimensions Diagram (Dec 4, 2018)Monoprice™, WORKSTREAM™, the WORKSTREAM logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
